summary: Frontend-only testing for Iteration 6 (header dropdowns + EV charger image). All 12 features from the review request pass on desktop (1920x1080) and mobile (390x844). No code changes needed.

desktop.nav_items_about_services_capabilities_po: PASS (all 6 present; About/Services/Credentials are dropdowns; Capabilities/Portfolio/Contact are direct links)
desktop.services_dropdown: PASS — 7 items numbered 01-07 with correct labels and hrefs (/#services-construction, /#services-electrical-mechanical, /#services-it, /#services-production, /#services-corporate-gift, /#services-ev-charger, /#services-laundry). data-testids nav-services-item-0..6.
desktop.ev_charger_click_flow: PASS — clicking nav-services-item-5 navigates to /#services-ev-charger, accordion auto-opens (aria-expanded=true), division-ev-charger-showcase visible with img src=/armeen/ev/charger.png (naturalWidth=1536 → image loaded), capability bullets visible, Enquire button present
desktop.construction_click_closes_ev: PASS — clicking nav-services-item-0 sets EV aria-expanded=false and Construction aria-expanded=true
desktop.hash_based_autoopen_direct_nav: PASS — navigating directly to /#services-laundry opens the laundry division (aria-expanded=true)
desktop.language_switch_bm: PASS — Services trigger label becomes 'Perkhidmatan' and item 0 becomes 'Pembinaan & Reka Bentuk Dalaman'

mobile_390x844.sub_item_tap_closes_drawer_and_navigates: PASS — tapping mobile EV item closes drawer and navigates to /#services-ev-charger; division auto-opens (aria-expanded=true)

tests_executed.console_errors: Only 2 expected 401s from /api/admin/me background check (logged-out state on public site). No functional errors.

critical_code_review_comments: Header.jsx: dropdown is hover-only on desktop with no keyboard/focus support — accessibility concern (tab key cannot expand submenu, aria-haspopup/aria-expanded missing on triggers). Not blocking for this iteration but worth a future a11y pass.

Services.jsx hashchange handler runs immediately on mount but if Services component mounts after the hash is already set during SPA route changes, the 200ms scrollIntoView delay is tight. Currently works because handler() is called inside useEffect.
EV charger image (1.3MB PNG) is loaded with loading='lazy' which is good, but consider compressing/serving as WebP for performance.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All Iteration 6 dropdown + EV-image flows verified on both desktop and mobile. Service division keys: construction, electrical-mechanical, it, production, corporate-gift, ev-charger, laundry. Dropdown nav data-testids: nav-<key>-trigger, nav-<key>-menu, nav-<key>-item-<i>. Mobile equivalents: mobile-nav-<key>-trigger, mobile-nav-<key>-menu, mobile-nav-<key>-item-<i>. Hash-based auto-open works via hashchange listener in Services.jsx. The 2 console 401s come from admin-session probe and are expected.
